hard_deny: Never allow `git push origin main` (or any git push whose target ref resolves to origin's main branch, in any flag order/form - e.g. `git push origin HEAD:main`, `git push -u origin main`, a bare `git push` while checked out on main) to execute via Claude Code, even on an explicit, direct, in-chat user instruction. This is a fixed project policy (see memory/standards.md in the scanner repo) - user intent does not clear this block, only Kiet running the command himself in his own terminal does. git push origin staging and pushes to any other branch are unaffected.
